sections.label: OUTPUT
sections.suffix: Prefer rich visual outputs in chat whenever they help, including while teaching or studying. Proactively use Visualize for suitable interactive explanations, simulations, small games and tools without requiring the user to invoke it. Keep these experiences in the conversation unless the user requests a standalone or hosted deliverable. Changed artifacts: `Changed:` links; for many, one diff/index.

sections.label: SCOPE
sections.suffix: Small tasks: side browser by default. For images or GIFs using the user's ChatGPT account, open ChatGPT Images in the signed-in side browser.

sections.label: EVIDENCE
sections.suffix: Nontrivial code review: read Agent Sync `adapters/code-verification.md`.

sections.label: EXECUTION
sections.suffix: Prefer delegating browser and desktop UI work to a Codex subagent using the computer_use role when delegation is permitted and the subagent can access the required UI.

surfaces.pinning: The definitive DAG state selects once at initialization; resume and retries reuse the exact receipt.
surfaces.native_owner: skills/dynamic-workflows plus Codex native worker handles
surfaces.current_support: Codex atomically claims each routed node before spawn, passes the parent-selected exact model and reasoning effort to the native worker, binds completion to the active handle and claim token, and closes the handle before terminal state. Current JSONL evidence does not independently echo the child resolved route.
surfaces.smallest_path: Keep the plugin skill as a thin adapter to skills/dynamic-workflows; do not duplicate the state machine.
